About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity

Carrot is expanding its telemedicine clinic with a network of part-time, fully remote physician consultants who deliver evidence-based virtual care to members across multiple U.S. states. Depending on your licensure, certification, and area of expertise, you will provide consultations in menopause and perimenopause care aligned to The Menopause Society and ACOG guidelines, early fertility support aligned to ACOG and ASRM guidelines, or both.

Metabolic health is a core, cross-cutting component of this program. Weight, insulin resistance, and cardiometabolic risk are central to outcomes across every journey we support, from ovulatory function and preconception readiness to menopausal symptom burden and long-term cardiovascular and bone health. You should expect metabolic assessment and management to be a routine part of your visits, and clinicians comfortable prescribing and managing anti-obesity medications, including GLP-1 receptor agonists, within clinical protocols are especially encouraged to apply.

This is a flexible, part-time contractor engagement of approximately 5-40 hours per week, with a target commitment of 10-15 hours per week.

What You’ll Own

In this role, you will:

  • Provide virtual consultations (video and/or phone) within your area(s) of expertise, including assessment, diagnosis, treatment planning, and ongoing management of menopausal, fertility, and related hormonal and metabolic concerns.
  • Apply current ACOG, ASRM, and The Menopause Society guidelines with individualized, shared decision-making.
  • Assess and manage metabolic health as a routine part of visits, including prescribing and managing anti-obesity medications such as GLP-1 receptor agonists within clinical protocols where appropriate.
  • Document visits accurately and on time, order and interpret relevant labs, and coordinate referrals to primary care, OB/GYN, endocrinology, behavioral health, or subspecialists as needed.
  • Maintain active, unrestricted multi-state clinical licensure, complete credentialing and payer enrollment, and maintain eligibility for additional state licenses to expand coverage.
  • Contribute to member experience and quality through strong virtual visit presence, effective use of telehealth and EHR systems, participation in chart audits and case reviews, and staying current with emerging research and regulatory changes.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Established a consistent panel of high-quality virtual visits within your clinical area(s), with strong member experience and visit quality results.
  • Maintained timely, accurate documentation and lab follow-up, with no outstanding credentialing or compliance gaps.
  • Expanded your state licensure coverage in line with program needs, supporting broader member access.
  • Integrated metabolic assessment and management, including GLP-1 protocols where clinically appropriate, as a routine part of your visits.
  • Contributed to chart audits, case reviews, and clinical protocol refinement as the telemedicine program scales.

About You ✨

You likely have:

  • An MD or DO in Obstetrics/Gynecology, Reproductive Endocrinology and Infertility (REI), Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, or Endocrinology; or you are a Physician Assistant (PA) or Advanced Practice Registered Nurse/Nurse Practitioner (e.g., WHNP, adult/gerontology NP, FNP) with demonstrated expertise in the applicable clinical area.
  • A minimum of 3-5+ years of active clinical experience in early fertility support, menopause care, or both, including evaluation, treatment, and longitudinal management.
  • An active, unrestricted U.S. medical license; multi-state licensure is preferred and IMLC participation is strongly preferred.
  • For clinicians practicing in the menopause specialty: MSCP certification from The Menopause Society, or certification actively in progress with a clear completion plan.
  • Familiarity with ACOG, ASRM, and The Menopause Society guidelines.
  • Prior telemedicine experience (preferred), with comfort managing visits entirely in a virtual environment and a strong virtual presence that supports shared decision-making over video and phone.
  • Proficiency with telehealth technologies, including video platforms, secure messaging, electronic prescribing, and EHR/clinical documentation tools.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA and applicable telemedicine privacy, security, and regulatory requirements, along with a HIPAA-compliant home workspace and reliable internet.

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Clinical experience spanning both early fertility and menopause, enabling flexible coverage across member journeys.
  • Experience working in a dedicated menopause clinic, fertility center, or comparable specialty program.
  • Familiarity with early fertility workup, including AMH testing, ovulation induction, and preconception optimization, with appropriate escalation to in-person ART evaluation.
  • Experience prescribing and managing anti-obesity medications, including GLP-1 receptor agonists (titration, side-effect management, monitoring, and discontinuation planning); obesity medicine training or ABOM certification is a significant advantage.
  • Prior experience in digital health, health benefits, or multi-state telemedicine environments.
  • Experience contributing to clinical protocol development, quality improvement, or member-facing clinical content.
  • Experience supporting diverse and historically underserved populations, including LGBTQ+ and gender-diverse individuals.
  • Fluency in an additional language.

Why This Role Matters

Carrot's telemedicine clinic is one of the most direct ways members experience our care. Every virtual visit shapes how members navigate some of the most personal moments of their lives, from trying to conceive to managing menopause. The clinicians in this network are the face of that experience, and the quality of their judgment, communication, and documentation determines whether members receive care they trust.

This role also anchors Carrot's clinical point of view that metabolic health is inseparable from reproductive and hormonal health. As the telemedicine program scales across states and journeys, the clinicians who join this network will directly expand access to guideline-aligned, whole-person care for members who often cannot find it locally.

Why Candidates Join Carrot

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation:

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $120-$160. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

Who We Are:

The Knowledge Graph Platform team builds the foundational systems that help Reddit understand entities, relationships, and context across its content. We are evolving an advanced, AI-powered knowledge graph into a reliable, scalable platform that enables teams across Reddit to build better experiences on top of shared, high-quality knowledge.

This is a high-leverage team at the intersection of data, platform engineering, and AI. Our work supports emerging capabilities such as contextual grounding while creating the contracts, standards, and developer experience that make shared data dependable and easy to use. This team is strategically positioned to impact both ads and consumer roadmaps. Our data is used across ads marketplace models as well as user-facing features on reddit.com.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers building Reddit’s Knowledge Graph Platform; create a high-trust, high-performing environment with clear goals and strong technical ownership.
  • Set the technical direction and roadmap for a scalable knowledge graph platform, including data and API contracts, service interfaces, reliability, observability, performance, and developer experience.
  • Leverage SOTA LLM and agentic patterns for knowledge graph construction.
  • Establish production-grade operating standards: defining SLOs, implementing quality measures of data within the knowledge graph, governance mechanisms, and safe change-management practices.
  • Partner with engineering, computational linguists, and domain-expert teams to define a shared operating model for ontology, data quality, governance, and platform evolution.
  • Be a steward of data in the KG - ensure the graph has the coverage and freshness needed for priority use cases. Work with our dedicated data labeler team on shared goals around data coverage and quality.
  • Work closely with internal product and engineering teams to understand their needs, prioritize high-value use cases, and increase access to the platform.
  • Drive the next wave of graph-powered capabilities, including opportunities in shopping, search, ads marketplace models, consumer feed models.
  • Stay close to architecture and technical design, helping the team navigate complex system tradeoffs and contribute hands-on when it is the highest-leverage path.
  • Communicate the team’s strategy, priorities, risks, and progress clearly across a distributed, cross-functional organization.

Who You Might Be:

  • 8+ years of total software engineering experience, with 2+ years directly managing, coaching, and developing engineering teams.
  • Experience with knowledge graphs, semantic or ontology systems, entity resolution, search, or contextual grounding is highly desired.
  • Experience building or operating AI/ML powered, or data-intensive platforms, with a proven track record of leading shared technical systems with multiple internal customers.
  • Strong understanding of how to turn a technical system into a product-like platform: setting an operating model with customers, establishing data or service-level contracts, useful documentation, and a path to self-service adoption.
  • Experience establishing data contracts around quality, lineage, or governance.
  • Strong technical judgment across distributed systems, backend services, data platforms, APIs, reliability, and operational excellence.
  • Comfortable making technical and product tradeoffs in ambiguity, including when a dedicated product manager is not present.
  • Excellent collaborator and communicator who can earn trust with engineers, senior leaders, and partner teams across time zones.
  • Enjoy building clarity and durable operating mechanisms where ownership and processes are still evolving. Excel in evangelization and driving platform adoption cross org.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

Nice to Have:

  • Master’s or Advanced Degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computational Linguistics, or a related field.

Location:

This role is 100% remote (US & Canada only) and will regularly meet with teams in the EU and the US. Candidates based in ET timezone will be given preference to accommodate team schedules.

Perks and Benefits:

  • 100% remote opportunity (we have 4 office locations for hybrid/onsite work preference in NY, SF, LA and Chicago)
  • Competitive salary and equity options
  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision) & workplace perks (home office set up stipend etc)
  • Generous 401k matching
  • Flexible vacation policy
  • Paid parental leave (4+ months)
  • Family planning support
  • Paid volunteer time off

#LI-AS1

Pay Transparency:

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/.

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below.

The base salary range for this position is:

$217,000—$303,900 USD

During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors.

Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.

Ajax Systems ist ein internationales Technologieunternehmen und der größte Hersteller von Sicherheitssystemen in Europa mit über 4,5 Millionen Endnutzern und 330.000 PRO-Nutzern in mehr als 180 Ländern weltweit. Das Unternehmen bietet End-to-End-Lösungen zum Schutz von Wohn- und Geschäftsobjekten jeder Größenordnung. Bis heute umfasst das Produktportfolio von Ajax 280 Geräte für Einbruchschutz, Videoüberwachung, Brand- und Lebenssicherheit sowie Komfort- und Automatisierungslösungen. Das Unternehmen beschäftigt 5.000 Spezialisten.

Wir bauen lokale Teams auf, weil wir davon überzeugt sind, dass lokale Experten die Besonderheiten ihres Marktes am besten verstehen. Ajax Systems ist weltweit mit Vertriebsmitarbeitern vertreten, unter anderem in Norwegen, Schweden, Dänemark, Finnland, Italien, Spanien, Deutschland, Frankreich, dem Vereinigten Königreich, den USA, Australien, Südafrika und weiteren Regionen. Das globale Business-Development-Team vereint Gleichgesinnte, die die ambitionierten Ziele von Ajax Systems teilen.

Die Kombination aus erstklassiger Software und leistungsstarker Hardware hat die Wahrnehmung von Sicherheitssystemen für Anwender und Branchenexperten nachhaltig verändert. Durch Anerkennungen auf den größten Fachmessen wie IFSEC, Expoprotection und Intersec sowie durch den Gewinn renommierter Auszeichnungen führender Branchenmedien wie dem PSI Magazine und GIT SECURITY zählt Ajax heute zu den meistausgezeichneten Sicherheitssystemen Europas.

Die Produktion von Ajax Systems umfasst vier Fabriken, davon zwei in der Ukraine, eine in der Türkei und eine in Vietnam. Gleichzeitig gewährleistet die ISO-14001-Zertifizierung des Unternehmens eine minimale Umweltbelastung durch die Produktion. Die Auswahl der Komponenten für die Herstellung der Ajax-Geräte basiert auf Herstellererklärungen, die die Einhaltung der RoHS-Richtlinien bestätigen.

Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und arbeiten Sie an Europas Sicherheitssystem mit den meisten Auszeichnungen mit!

Voraussetzungen und Anforderungen an einen Regional Business Development Manager:

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich elektronischer Sicherheitssysteme (z. B. Intrusion, Video, Zutritt, Brand)
  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb oder in der Unternehmensentwicklung in einem vertikalen B2B-Markt.
  • Deutschkenntnisse auf Muttersprachniveau (in Wort und Schrift).
  • Ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise mit Eigeninitiative und Verantwortung für die eigenen Ergebnisse.
  • Verhandlungsgeschick: starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sowohl am Telefon als auch im persönlichen Gespräch.
  • Hoch motiviert mit der Fähigkeit, Dinge zu verwirklichen.
  • Professionelles Auftreten, zuverlässiges und ethisches Verhalten.

Der Business Development Manager von Ajax Systems soll daher als Botschafter des Unternehmens und der Marke fungieren und die folgenden Aufgaben erfüllen:

  • Werbung für die Produkte und Dienstleistungen von Ajax Systems bei Systemintegratoren, Errichtern, Fachberatern und Endverbrauchern (Geschäftspartnern) in Deutschland.
  • Erkundung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und Organisation von Treffen mit Geschäftspartnern.
  • Planung und Vorbereitung von Präsentationen für Geschäftspartner und andere interessierte Personengruppen.
  • Aufbau und Erhaltung von Beziehungen zu Kooperationspartnern und Leitstellen.
  • Kommunikation von Produktfunktionen, Vorteilen und Entwicklungen an Geschäftspartner.
  • Durchführung von Produkt- und Handelsschulungen in Zusammenarbeit mit den Geschäftspartnern.
  • Aktive Förderung der Spezifikation von Systemen, die Produkte und Lösungen von Ajax Systems enthalten.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Vertriebspartnern von Markenprodukten, um die Anforderungen der Geschäftspartner zu erfüllen.
  • Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung von Marktstrategien für Produkte und Lösungen von Ajax Systems.
  • Rückmeldung an das Management über die Anforderungen an aktuelle und zukünftige Produkte und Lösungen von Ajax Systems.
  • Erstellen von genauen und zeitnahen Berichten unter Verwendung des CRM-Systems des Unternehmens zur Unterstützung der eigenen Aufgaben oder entsprechend den Anforderungen des Managements.

Wir bieten:

  • Wettbewerbsfähige Löhne - und ein transparentes Motivationssystem;
  • Ein Produkt, das sich selbst verkauft;
  • Bezahlung von Schulungen und Konferenzen, die wir für unsere Mitarbeiter durchführen;
  • Ein starkes, gut eingespieltes Team von Fachleuten;
  • Firmenwagen und alle Geschäftskosten abgedeckt.

Compensation

Additional Information

Wir arbeiten dafür, dass das Leben der Menschen friedlich und die Welt sicher ist. Werden Sie Teil des Teams, das ein intelligentes und sinnvolles globales Produkt herstellt.

Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

Why This Role Matters

Our GTM Analytics team owns the metrics that run the business for Sales, Marketing, and Client Success. We're past the phase of standing up basic reporting — we're now building a modern, agentic analytics practice, including Lighthouse, our internal BI-as-code platform, where dashboards, metrics, and semantic definitions live in version-controlled code rather than scattered across disconnected tools.

This role is a chance to shape that next chapter. You'll partner directly with Sales, Marketing, and CS leaders to answer their hardest questions about pipeline, funnel conversion, campaign performance, and retention, while helping build the infrastructure and AI-forward workflows that let the whole GTM org get trustworthy answers faster.

You'll report to our Senior Manager of Analytics and work in tight, two-week sprints alongside Analytics Engineering, so you'll see your work ship and get used — fast.

What You'll Do

GTM Analysis & Decision Support

  • Deliver decision-ready analysis across Sales, Marketing, and Client Success: pipeline health, funnel conversion, campaign and channel performance, cohort/retention, and GRR/NRR drivers.

  • Partner directly with Sales, Marketing, and CSM stakeholders to scope questions, frame recommendations, and see analysis through to a decision — not just a dashboard handoff.

  • Bring structure to ambiguous asks — translate a stakeholder's question into a clear, testable analytical approach.

Data Modeling & Quality

  • Build and maintain dbt models and marts for Sales, Marketing, and CS domains, with Salesforce as a core source system.

  • Own data quality and documentation for your domain: clear definitions, source-of-truth tables, and QA that stakeholders can trust without double-checking.

Lighthouse & Agentic Analytics

  • Contribute to Lighthouse, our BI-as-code platform, as we build it out — help define how dashboards, metrics, and semantic models get written, versioned, and reviewed like software.

  • Note: Lighthouse is an active build, not a finished platform — you'll be shaping it, not just using it.

  • Push our analytics workflows toward agentic AI: using AI agents to accelerate analysis, automate recurring reporting, and cut down on manual, one-off dashboard requests.

  • Bring a point of view on where AI can replace manual analyst work versus where it can't — you should be as comfortable prompting and evaluating an agent as writing the SQL yourself.

How You'll Work

  • Operate in two-week sprints, planning and prioritizing your own backlog against team OKRs alongside your manager.

  • Give clear, proactive status updates to stakeholders rather than waiting to be asked.

What We're Looking For

Experience

  • 5+ years in analytics/BI, with meaningful time supporting Sales, Marketing, or Customer Success functions at a fast-growing company. Staff-level candidates should bring deeper scope — larger or more ambiguous problems owned end-to-end, and a track record of setting technical direction, not just executing against it.

  • Expert SQL and hands-on dbt experience modeling GTM data.

  • Comfortable with Python for analysis and automation — this isn't a heavy ML/stats role, but you know how to script your way out of manual work.

  • Experience with Salesforce as a data source — you understand CRM objects, fields, and the quirks of modeling data.

  • Familiarity with a modern data stack: Fivetran or similar EL tooling, and a cloud warehouse (we run Snowflake; BigQuery experience also welcome).

BI & AI Fluency

  • Experience with at least one modern BI tool (Sigma, Hex, Tableau, Looker, or similar) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement — what matters more is that you understand how modern BI organizations operate: governed semantic layers, self-serve dashboards, and BI-as-code approaches.

  • Genuine curiosity about agentic analytics — you've used AI agents or LLM tools to speed up analysis, and you want to help define what that looks like at scale.

  • We build with Claude day-to-day, so hands-on experience with Claude Code (or a similar coding agent like Codex) is a big plus — you'll use it to move faster on dbt models, scripting, and analysis, not just as a novelty.

Mindset

  • Strong communicator who can frame a recommendation clearly for a non-technical stakeholder and defend it under questioning.

  • Comfortable with the accountability of owning a deliverable through to closure, not just the analysis in the middle.

  • Energized by ambiguity and fast iteration — two-week sprints mean you'll ship early and often.

Compensation

Additional Information

Join us in shaping the future of real estate

The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.

We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.

Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.

More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.

Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform.

Luxury Presence is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers, including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

At Envato, we empower creative pros to thrive.

We're here to help creatives bring their ideas to life, supercharge their workflows, and equip them with an unparalleled toolkit they can use anywhere. About the role

Provides reliable, high-quality content review capacity, initially focused on Print Templates, Social Media, and related Graphics categories.

The role is designed to progressively expand its coverage through structured cross-training and calibration, developing the ability to review additional General Graphics and media categories as operational needs evolve.

The role also supports continuous improvement through knowledge sharing, process feedback, and the effective use of review tools, including AI-assisted workflows.

Offers guidance, mentoring, calibration, and support for AI-driven workflows to drive the continuous enhancement of the Envato Library.

What you'll be doing

  • Independently review Print Templates, Social Media templates, General Graphics, and related design assets against technical, aesthetic, usability, and marketplace standards.
  • Perform hands-on Photo, Video, Motion Graphics, and other media reviews according to documented guidelines and category-specific calibration; flex capacity in response to queue priorities.

  • Handle complex, ambiguous, escalated, and integrity-related content evaluations; escalate legal or IP concerns through established channels.
  • Lead reviewer calibrations, support guideline interpretation, and mentor reviewers to improve cross-category accuracy and consistency.

  • Actively participate in a structured cross-training roadmap, achieving independent review capability in additional Graphics queues within the first six months and supporting broader cross-category coverage within twelve months.

  • 2+ years of professional experience in graphic design, creative content quality assurance, stock content review, or a related digital media discipline.
  • Advanced expertise in Print Templates and General Graphics, including typography, layout, prepress/print readiness, editable files, and technical quality standards.

Consultant, Patient Experience

Why We Have This Role

Patient experience directly drives overall healthcare quality, provider engagement, and operational success. In this role, you will help healthcare organizations transform their patient experience strategy by translating data into actionable insights and high-impact improvement initiatives. Working alongside C-suite executives, healthcare providers, and our internal Strategic Consulting practice, you will lead high-impact client engagements that drive measurable results. If you are passionate about applying strategic consulting principles to solve complex challenges in healthcare, this role gives you the platform to make a lasting difference.

How You’ll Find Success

  • Translates Insights to Strategy: Easily connects patient experience data and analytics to actionable, real-world execution plans for executive leaders.
  • Builds Trusted Relationships: Rapidly establishes credibility and trust with C-suite executives, boards, and clinical teams to serve as an advisor.

  • Facilitates with Impact: Highly engaging facilitator and trainer capable of leading dynamic executive presentations and workshop sessions.
  • Collaborates Across Teams: Connects the right internal subject matter expertise, tools, and technologies to solve unique client priorities.
  • Identifies Growth Opportunities: Proactively identifies emerging market trends and needs to help expand client relationships and consulting offerings.

How You’ll Grow

  • Expand your strategic consulting expertise across diverse healthcare systems, boards, and C-suite leadership teams.
  • Deepen your mastery of healthcare analytics, patient experience methodologies, and performance improvement frameworks.
  • Contribute directly to internal innovation by creating new consulting methodologies, tools, and solution offerings.
  • Gain hands-on business development experience and mentorship from senior leadership (Associate Principals, Principals, and Partners).

Things You’ll Do

  • Drive Strategic Patient Experience Initiatives: Lead high-impact client engagements to deliver world-class patient experience consulting, diagnostic assessments, and execution roadmaps.
  • Influence C-Suite Decision Making: Synthesize complex quantitative and qualitative healthcare data into compelling executive-level presentations and recommendations.
  • Facilitate Change Management & Capability Building: Serve as an expert trainer and workshop facilitator to upskill client providers, staff, and leadership teams.
  • Expand Client Relationships & Pipeline: Proactively identify client needs and partner internally to deliver comprehensive solutions that drive practice revenue growth.
  • Advance Consulting Methodology: Contribute to internal innovation efforts to build, test, and deploy new consulting tools, technologies, and framework offerings.
  • Maintain Engagement Excellence: Consistently deliver high-quality outputs while managing personal utilization to meet established performance targets.

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

  • 5+ years of relevant healthcare industry experience, with deep familiarity with healthcare market trends.
  • Demonstrated expertise using patient experience data, analytics, and methodologies to drive organizational change.
  • Prior experience implementing improvement initiatives across Experience, Safety, Engagement, Quality, or Performance domains.
  • Proven track record in management/strategic consulting (strongly preferred), including consulting business development exposure.
  • Strong background in executive-level presentation, workshop facilitation, and qualitative/quantitative analytical methods.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; ability to travel up to 75%.

What You Should Know About This Team

  • High-Impact Healthcare Mission: We partner directly with C-suite healthcare leaders to solve some of the most critical challenges in patient experience, safety, and operational performance.
  • Collaborative & Multi-Disciplinary: We operate in dynamic teams that connect specialized tools, cross-functional experts, and data-driven insights to deliver maximum client value.
  • Culture of Continuous Innovation: We actively encourage team members to refine our methodologies, invent new frameworks, and influence how our consulting practice evolves.
  • Direct Access to Practice Leadership: You will work directly with Associate Principals, Principals, and Partners who are committed to mentoring and advancing your career trajectory.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a dynamic, high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $20k to $100k, and involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

This is a remote position, open to candidates based in Mexico.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • 2+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role
  • Experience independently closing new deals larger than $10,000 in annual revenue.
  • Spanish speaker required (verbal and written)
  • Must be located in Mexico

An ideal candidate has:

  • Proven track record of consistent quota achievement
  • Experience selling in the midmarket space - medium to large deals sizes
  • Experience with high-volume cold calling
  • Must demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process
  • SFDC familiarity
  • Experience selling into Mexico or Latin America
  • Ability to think strategically and creatively in a new market
  • Excellent understanding of business acumen for emerging markets
  • Ability to manage logistics of selling into Mexico from North America

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

You'll own retention and expansion across your portfolio, creating new revenue opportunities through increased usage, new products, use cases, business units and geographic expansion.

We're looking for someone with a hunter mentality who doesn't wait for opportunities to come to them. You'll use customer relationships, business insight and data to identify whitespace, build qualified expansion pipeline and turn opportunities into measurable revenue growth.

  • Build a strong understanding of Veriff's products, customers, consumption-based commercial model and the industries represented across your portfolio.

  • Experience managing LATAM enterprise customers.

  • Stock options that ensure your share in our success

  • Extensive medical, dental, and vision insurance to ensure you’re feeling great physically and mentally

  • Shape the strategy: Have a direct seat at the table in shaping Cribl’s GTM strategy as we scale our multi-product platform (Stream, Edge, Lake, Search).
  • Embrace modern work: Work in a remote-first, collaborative environment where you are encouraged to challenge legacy processes and use AI to reinvent everyday workflows.

    • Build and lead a team of Solutions Engineers and SE Managers who serve as our core product introduction, evaluation, and education experts across Cribl's full platform.

At Cribl, we're transforming from a flagship-product company into a multi-product powerhouse - and every non-routine business event, whether an acquisition, a product launch, or a go-to-market shift, adds complexity our data, definitions, and reporting weren't built to handle. As the Analytics Business Partner, you're the person who closes that gap - translating a new product or customer into our existing data, systems and reporting: how it connects to what we already have, how value is attributed, how we define and track it going forward. Reporting to the VP of Data & Analytics — part of Cribl's broader Business Operations organization alongside Strategy & Operations and Business Effectiveness — you'll operate horizontally across the business rather than embedding in a single function.

This is a high-impact role for a strategist who thrives on ambiguity and builds order from chaos. If you are eager to contribute to a company poised for generational success, we want to hear from you.


As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

  • Diagnose and Drive the Solution. When a non-routine business event doesn't fit with how we currently track or report on the business, define the solution. Whether a system change, a new process or policy, or a different data model, serve as the Directly Responsible Individual (DRI) for working with the necessary x-functional teams to get it delivered
  • M&A Integration. When we acquire a company, own and drive how its products and customers fit into our existing reporting and data models, ensuring we can capture the impact of the acquisition post deal close
  • New Product Launch. When we launch a new product, understand how Product defines its success metrics, and make sure our models, definitions, and reporting can track against those metrics post launch
  • Keep Execution Moving. When a change spans across the Data and Analytics team (Data Engineering, Analytics, Data Science, Data Governance), sequence who does what first, own the handoffs between them, catch duplication or gaps before they cost the team time, and push the pace when the event demands it
  • Stand Up the Business Intelligence Council. Establish and run the forum where cross-functional leaders align on key measures, attributes, and hierarchy definitions, and on prioritization across competing data and analytics efforts — and drive it to actual resolution, rather than let it stall as a standing meeting.
  • Know The Business. Maintain a working picture of how GTM, Finance, Product, and other functions operate, knowing who to engage so a project doesn’t start or drift, without the right people engaged. For example, understanding how Product Marketing is positioning a new feature, how it needs to be represented across our applications in partnership with IT, and how Finance will measure its impact, before scoping the data work for it.
  • We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones – you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours

If You've Got It - We Want It

  • 8+ years in management consulting, in-house strategy, business operations, or business analytics, with a track record of operating in unfamiliar functions and reframing ambiguously-posed questions
  • Fluency across GTM, Finance, Product, and other functions - enough to know that 'customer' may mean something different to Sales than it does to Finance, and to reconcile the difference rather than pick a side
  • You can join multiple tables, write a CTE, and get the aggregation grain right - enough to answer your own question - though hands-on query and dashboard work won't be your primary responsibility in this role
  • Given a reporting issue, you know not to default to a “data-only” answer - you can tell whether the real problem is a system that isn't capturing the right data, a process nobody owns, or a data model that no longer matches the business
  • Ability to flex your communication style as needed - equally fluent giving execs the top-line takeaway and working through the nuances with the operational teams to drive a solution
  • First hand experience ensuring a business’s data and reporting keep up following an acquisition or new product launch - designing and driving the solution so the business doesn’t lose visibility into itself
  • Bonus: experience inside a post-close M&A integration, a new product introduction, or a go-to-market model change
  • Bonus: experience in late-stage B2B SaaS startups (i.e., Series E+) and / or early public B2B SaaS companies (e.g., 3-5k employees)

Who is Tenable?

Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!

What makes Tenable such a great place to work?

Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

Your Role:

The Associate Services Architect is a content-focused role responsible for creating, updating, and maintaining technical content for the Professional Services Portfolio. This role blends technical aptitude with content development and communication skills, working under the mentorship of a Senior Services Architect or Manager to design, draft, and update consulting service offerings, training content, and enablement material.

This position is specifically scoped around portfolio maintenance: keeping existing courses, labs, and collateral current as products evolve, and absorbing update-tier and Tier-1 support work so that Senior Services Architects can focus their time on strategic development and net-new offerings. The role receives structured intake and mentoring support from their manager and works closely with the broader Services Architecture team.

Your Opportunity:

Content Creation & Maintenance:

  • Content Updates: Design, draft, and update consulting service offerings, enablement content, educational material, and technical presentations for webinars and events.
  • Maintenance Backlog: Own update-tier fixes and content refreshes for existing courses and labs, keeping material current as Tenable products evolve.
  • Collateral Support: Create collateral for new offerings and evaluate existing offerings and content for accuracy and relevance.
  • Services Offerings: Help create and support the development of consulting services offerings.

Delivery & Review:

  • Pre-Production Training: Deliver pre-production training sessions to evaluate product suitability and gather early feedback.
  • Live Demonstrations: Create live demonstration recordings for the Tenable product suite.
  • Content Review: Perform content reviews with peers in Services, Technical Support, Customer Success, and Product Management to ensure quality and alignment with customer needs.
  • Quality Assurance: Review and validate updated course materials and lab environments to ensure technical accuracy and consistency before release.
  • Service Offerings Review: Participate in the review and validation of new consulting service offerings to ensure alignment with portfolio standards and technical feasibility.

Strategic Engagement & Support:

  • Customer & Partner Engagement: Engage with customers and partners to analyze market trends and the competitive landscape.
  • Cross-Functional Problem Solving: Work closely with all departments to identify and resolve problems, gathering information to support data-driven decisions.
  • Tier-1 Support Coverage: Provide first-line responses to Customer Care escalations on assigned courses, triaging and resolving routine issues before they require senior architect time.
  • Staying Current: Remain abreast of corporate direction and strategy, product roadmaps, messaging, and emerging trends in the security industry.

Project & Process Management:

  • Independent Delivery: Independently manage assigned projects on schedule, escalating risks and dependencies early.
  • Process Improvement: Remain abreast of educational frameworks, content development approaches, and technologies that may reduce costs or shorten development timelines.
  • Other Duties: May perform other duties and responsibilities that management may deem necessary from time to time.

What You’ll Need:

  • Security Foundations: 1–3 years of overall experience in Information Security, or equivalent training/education/services.
  • Vulnerability Management Exposure: Some exposure to vulnerability management concepts; prior experience with the Tenable product suite is a plus.
  • Content or Training Background: Experience in technical writing, instructional design, or training delivery is beneficial but not required.
  • Services Experience: Prior experience in professional services or consulting environments is highly valued.
  • Education: B.S. degree in Computer Science or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.
  • Technical Foundations: Working knowledge of TCP/IP networking; foundational understanding of Windows and Linux operating systems.
  • Security Tools Familiarity: Familiarity with security assessment tools such as Nessus, Kali Linux, or Metasploit is a plus.
  • Emerging Domains: Exposure to web application security, container security, or cloud environments (AWS/Azure) is a plus but not required at this level.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Autonomy with Support: Able to work remotely as part of a geographically distributed team, with structured mentoring and support from their manager.
  • Ability to work remotely in a self-directed manner
  • Physically able to participate in training sessions, presentations and meetings
  • Some Tenable office travel may be required

About Us

At TeamSnap, we believe when the world connects through sports; the world becomes better. TeamSnap is a sports and communication platform dedicated to taking the work out of play in youth sports. We also believe our jobs should excite us, our teammates should support us and our bosses should inspire us. We empower our people to bring big ideas and tiny egos, landing us on Outside Magazine’s list of “Best Places to Work" and Built In’s “100 Best Remote-First Places to Work."

TeamSnap is hiring a Principal Product Manager, Ads to reimagine and build an advertising solution for the next generation of our platform.

TeamSnap today has a scaled advertising business. For years, top national and regional brands have reached millions of youth sports families through the TeamSnap app. What's next is building an ad product for where we're going. As we bring our millions of parents, coaches, and players onto a new, unified TeamSnap experience, the ads business gets rebuilt with it, from a blank slate.

This is a unique and rare product opportunity. You'll be rebuilding advertising at a company that has already proven the demand — real advertisers, real revenue — and playing the lead role in deciding what the future of advertising looks like at TeamSnap. The formats, the placements, the measurement, and the standards that keep all of it worthy of the families who trust us and deliver on our advertisers' objectives.

You'll own the product side of that ad platform end to end — partnering with Design on native ad experiences, with Engineering on the serving and measurement infrastructure, and with our Ad Sales team on the inventory and packaging they take to market. You'll report to VP Product and work closely with senior leaders across the company on one of TeamSnap's top strategic priorities.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the advertising product roadmap end to end — from ad format and placement strategy through serving infrastructure, targeting, measurement, and reporting.

  • Design and launch native, integrated ad experiences in partnership with Product Design. Our thesis is that ads on TeamSnap should feel like part of the product and drive value for both our consumer users and advertisers.

  • Own the serving and targeting stack: ad server implementation, trafficking and campaign delivery workflows, private marketplace deal setup, and the first-party signal work that makes our inventory worth buying — getting the right context to the ad call so it can be used for targeting.

  • Build the measurement foundation: impression and viewability tracking, event instrumentation, third-party verification where advertisers require it, advertiser-facing reporting, and the experimentation framework to improve placements and creative over time.

  • Own ad quality, density, and user experience standards — where ads appear, how often, and what we won't do.

  • Partner with Ad Sales and Revenue Operations to turn product capability into sellable inventory — packaging, the targeting taxonomy they sell against, rate card inputs, and campaign delivery and pacing.

  • Model and forecast the business. Build the volume, fill rate, and eCPM models that tell us which placements are worth building, and what has to be true for a given format to pay for itself.

  • Own privacy and compliance requirements for ad targeting and data use, in partnership with Legal — including how children's data is treated, given the families we serve.

  • Work in ambiguity. Break down an undefined space into a sequenced plan, make practical tradeoffs between revenue, engineering cost, and user impact, and bring partners along with a clear point of view.

What Will Set You Up for Success:

  • 7-10 years in product management, with meaningful time spent on the publisher/supply side of the ads ecosystem — building and monetizing ad inventory inside a consumer product.

  • Direct experience launching or scaling ad products in a consumer mobile app (iOS and Android), including the platform-specific realities: SDK integration, ATT and IDFA, store policy, app release cycles, and how those constrain what you can ship and when.

  • Deep, hands-on technical fluency with the publisher ad stack: ad server implementation and trafficking (Google Ad Manager or equivalent), programmatic guaranteed and private marketplace deals, key-value and audience targeting, ad SDK integration, VAST and video formats. You should be able to hold your own in an engineering design review.

  • Command of the economics: fill rate, eCPM, RPM, sell-through, viewability, latency, and how each moves in response to product decisions. Comfortable pricing inventory without an auction to tell you what it's worth. You can build the model yourself and defend the assumptions.

  • Experience working alongside a direct ad sales organization — translating between what sales wants to sell and what the product can actually deliver, and building the packaging that closes the gap.

  • Demonstrated judgment about ads and user experience. A track record of shipping monetization that didn't degrade the product, and clear thinking on where the lines belong.

  • Strong data instincts. Comfortable in product analytics tools (Amplitude or similar) and SQL-adjacent enough to interrogate your own funnels rather than waiting on someone else to.

Bonus:

  • Experience with rewarded video, pre-roll, or other video monetization formats.

  • Background in a subscription business where advertising had to coexist with a paid tier without cannibalizing it.

  • Working knowledge of children's privacy regimes — COPPA and its state-level equivalents — as they apply to advertising.

  • First-party data and audience signal work: building the pipeline that carries publisher context into targeting decisions.

  • Familiarity with sports, media, or a community-driven consumer platform.

Compensation

Additional Information

Got cold feet? If you're thinking you don't meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying. We're all humans with special talents that go beyond what's listed here.

Compensation

We're committed to equitable compensation for all TeamSnappers. The minimum starting point for this role is $180,000 inclusive of base and bonus, with comp updated based on multiple factors. Our comp is highly competitive in our space and we adjust overall comp based on relevant experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location.

Location

TeamSnap is a fully remote company, so you need to be very comfortable working with people who aren’t in the same time zone as you. We are always expanding, but there is a small list of states we do not hire in, including Alabama, Alaska, Delaware, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Rhode Island, South Dakota West Virginia and Utah and while we love all parts of the world, we can only hire permanent US residents at this time.

Opportunities to Grow

At TeamSnap, we work hard to provide a culture of trust, accountability, inclusivity, and boundless opportunities to grow, along with the chance to make a lasting impact and have some fun while doing it.

Total Rewards

• We're proud to be remote-first. We've been remote since 2009, long before COVID made it cool

• Unlimited PTO and paid parental leave for ALL parents (not just primary or secondary)

• 100% premium coverage of medical/dental/vision for you and your family

• 401K to help you invest for the future

• $1,500 annual learning and development stipend

• Travel to fun locations for all-company meetings and team events

• Generous home office allowance to set you up for success

• TeamSnap SWAG to our store upon starting and a $50 credit on every work anniversary thereafter

• A monthly stipend reimbursement for health & wellness and so much more!

• TeamSnap Total Rewards

Working at TeamSnap

At TeamSnap, you're not a culture fit, you're a culture add. Check out our Culture Playbook and learn how we succeed at being remote-first, what makes our company so unique, and how we're inspired by our people, our customers, and our values.

Inclusion and Diversity

Creativity and innovation can't thrive when we're cookie-cutter images of each other. We’re quickly growing more diverse, but there's always room for improvement. We are committed to inclusion and diversity at TeamSnap, and we hold ourselves accountable for building an environment where everyone feels valued. If you need any disability-related adaptation during the recruitment process, just let us know! We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.
